你是外贸合规审核员。下面给你一段待发布的文本，以及一组规则（每条有编号、规则原文摘录和要判断的问题）。

只根据给出的规则判断。另外会给你工厂与产品资料，用来核对待审文本里的价格、条款、材料、认证等事实；资料本身不是待审对象。
如果待审文本与资料一致、也符合规则，就不要报。对每一个问题：
- 必须写 `rule_id`：只能是下面列出的规则编号之一。
- 必须写 `quote`：从待审文本里逐字复制出有问题的那一小段（不超过 20 个词）。
- 写不出规则编号或原文片段的问题，不要输出。宁可漏报，不要编造。
- severity：red = 明确违反规则；amber = 有风险、需要人确认。
- problem_zh / suggestion_zh 用简体中文，suggestion 给出具体改法。

只输出 JSON：
{"findings": [{"rule_id": "...", "quote": "...", "severity": "red|amber", "problem_zh": "...", "suggestion_zh": "..."}]}
如果没有问题：{"findings": []}

## 平台
阿里巴巴国际站 · RFQ 回复

## 规则
[
 {
  "rule_id": "ALI-01",
  "title_zh": "产品属性必须与实物一致",
  "excerpt": "Product attributes must be consistent with the actual condition of the product, and accurately showing the ingredients, materials, sizes, brands, models, places of origin",
  "question_zh": "回复或文案里的材质、尺寸、型号、产地等属性是否与已知产品资料一致（例如是否把塑料手柄/盖子的水壶说成全不锈钢）？"
 },
 {
  "rule_id": "ALI-02",
  "title_zh": "付款与发货条件须符合真实能力",
  "excerpt": "Payment and shipping options must be consistent with the actual service capability of suppliers.",
  "question_zh": "回复中承诺的起订量、交期、港口、付款方式或单价，是否都有供应商提供的资料支撑，而不是模型自己编的？"
 },
 {
  "rule_id": "ALI-03",
  "title_zh": "发布的信息须真实、准确、合法",
  "excerpt": "Member should ensure that all information you post on the Sites is true, accurate and lawful and should not be false or misleading",
  "question_zh": "回复中是否有无法由产品资料证实、可能虚假或误导买家的说法（例如未提供证书却声称已获某认证）？"
 },
 {
  "rule_id": "INC-01",
  "title_zh": "FOB / FAS 只适用于海运和内河运输",
  "excerpt": "Both apply only to sea or inland waterway transport (i.e. port-to-to port shipments).",
  "question_zh": "回复是否在空运、快递或陆运场景下使用了 FOB/FAS/CFR/CIF？"
 },
 {
  "rule_id": "INC-02",
  "title_zh": "集装箱货物更适合用 FCA",
  "excerpt": "FCA (Free Carrier) is the more appropriate Incoterms® rule.",
  "question_zh": "整柜或拼柜的集装箱报价用了 FOB 时，回复是否提示 FCA 可能更合适（可以作为可选项，不要求替换）？"
 },
 {
  "rule_id": "INC-03",
  "title_zh": "FOB：装上买方指定船只即完成交货，风险同时转移",
  "excerpt": "the seller delivers the goods loaded on board the vessel nominated by the buyer at the port of shipment",
  "question_zh": "回复对 FOB 的解释（谁订船、谁付运费、风险何时转移）是否与“装上买方指定船只即交货、风险转移”一致？"
 },
 {
  "rule_id": "INC-04",
  "title_zh": "CFR / CIF 只适用于海运和内河运输",
  "excerpt": "Both Incoterms® CIF and Incoterms® CFR are used for sea or inland waterway transportation only.",
  "question_zh": "回复是否在非海运场景下报了 CFR 或 CIF？"
 },
 {
  "rule_id": "INC-05",
  "title_zh": "CFR / CIF 风险在装运港装船时转移",
  "excerpt": "risk of loss of or damage to the goods transfers when the goods are placed on board the vessel at the port of shipment",
  "question_zh": "回复是否错误地表示 CFR/CIF 下卖方要承担运输途中直到目的港的风险？"
 }
]

## 工厂与产品资料（只用来核对事实，不是待审文本）

## 待审文本（按字段）
{
 "reply": "Hi Mark,\n\nThank you for your inquiry about our 1.7L Stainless Steel Electric Kettle (model KET-17S). I'm glad to support your Amazon business in Texas. Here are our product details, quote, and some important points before you decide.\n\n1. Certification and material (please read first)\n- UL / ETL: We do not currently hold UL or ETL listing for this model. Our current certifications are a CB report (IEC 60335-2-15) and CE (LVD/EMC). If UL listing is a firm requirement for your US sales channel, I don't want you to place an order based on a wrong assumption. Please let me know how you'd like to proceed.\n- BPA: The water-contact inner body is 304 stainless steel, and the lid and handle are PP plastic. However, we do not have a BPA test report, so we cannot provide documentation to support a \"BPA free\" claim at this time.\n\n2. Product highlights\n- 1.7L capacity, 1500W, 120V 60Hz (US version)\n- 304 stainless steel inner body\n- Auto shut-off and boil-dry protection\n- 360° swivel base\n- Concealed heating element for easy cleaning\n- Boils 1.7L in about 5 minutes (based on our internal factory test, not a third-party report)\n\n3. Price\n- 1,200 pcs: USD 9.80 per unit, FOB Ningbo, by sea\n- For reference: 2,000 to 4,999 pcs at USD 9.20 per unit; 5,000+ pcs at USD 8.70 per unit\n- MOQ: 500 pcs, so your 1,200 pcs first order is no problem.\n- Packaging: color box, 6 units per carton\n\n4. Your logo on the box\nSince your order is over 1,000 pcs, printing your logo on the color box is free of charge. We just need your logo in vector format (AI, EPS, or PDF).\n\n5. Lead time\nOur standard production lead time is 35 days after we receive the deposit and approve the artwork. We cannot meet a 20-day delivery. FOB is a sea-freight term, so our quote is based on shipment from Ningbo-Zhoushan port. If you prefer air freight, your forwarder can arrange it, but the 35-day production time still applies.\n\n6. Payment terms\nWe are unable to accept 100% payment 60 days after delivery. We can offer either of these options:\n- 30% T/T deposit, with the 70% balance paid against a copy of the B/L\n- L/C at sight\n\n7. Ways to check our quality and factory\n- Samples: We charge samples at the ex-factory unit price, and you cover the international shipping. The sample cost will be deducted from your bulk order.\n- Video factory tour: We can arrange a live video call through Alibaba to show you our production line.\n\nIf the certification status and terms above work for you, I'd suggest starting with a sample so you can check the quality yourself. Just send me your logo file and shipping details and I'll prepare a formal PI right away. If UL listing is essential, please let me know and we can discuss what is possible.\n\nLooking forward to your reply.\n\nBest regards,\n[Your Name]\nSales Representative\nYongjiang Small Appliances\nNingbo, China"
}

content: {"findings": [{"rule_id": "INC-01", "quote": "If you prefer air freight, your forwarder can arrange it", "severity": "amber", "problem_zh": "回复已说明 FOB 是海运条款，但随后提出可改空运，却没有说明空运时需要换贸易术语。买家可能以为空运仍按 FOB Ningbo 成交，而 FOB 只适用于海运和内河运输。", "suggestion_zh": "改为：\"If you prefer air freight, we can re-quote on FCA Ningbo (or EXW) terms, as FOB applies only to sea shipments; the 35-day production time still applies.\""}, {"rule_id": "INC-02", "quote": "1,200 pcs: USD 9.80 per unit, FOB Ningbo, by sea", "severity": "amber", "problem_zh": "1200 个（约 200 箱）属于集装箱货物（拼柜或整柜），报价只用了 FOB，没有提示 FCA 可能更合适。", "suggestion_zh": "保留 FOB 报价，补充一句：\"As this shipment will move by container, FCA Ningbo is also available and may better reflect the actual handover point — just let us know your preference.\""}]}
